posts.title: Antisemitism during the 2026 Iran war - Wikipedia
posts.description: On March 14, 2026, a Jewish school in Amsterdam was damaged by an explosion, characterised by the city's mayor as a deliberate attack against the Jewish community. Jewish people in Amsterdam are increasingly confronted with antisemitism.

posts.title: Explosion at Jewish School in Amsterdam Is 2nd Antisemitic Attack in 2 Days
posts.description: Explosive devices were set off at a Jewish school in Amsterdam and a synagogue in Rotterdam within two days. Dutch officials denounced the attacks as antisemitic.

posts.title: Counterterror police probe arson attack at former synagogue as Britain struggles with wave of antisemitism
posts.description: Counterterror police are investigating an arson attack at a former London synagogue as Prime Minister Keir Starmer addresses a wave of antisemitic attacks causing fear in the Jewish community.

posts.title: Amsterdam Jewish school struck by explosion in wave of antisemitic attacks
posts.description: An explosion struck overnight at a Jewish school in Amsterdam in what the city's mayor called a targeted attack against the Jewish community.

posts.title: Attacks on synagogues and Jewish shops in the UK, Europe and the US don't hurt Netanyahu. They just hurt ordinary Jews
posts.description: Attacks on synagogues and Jewish shops across the UK, Europe and US are rising, hurting ordinary Jewish communities.

posts.title: Belgium to deploy soldiers to help protect Jewish sites as Iran war fuels antisemitism
posts.description: Against a backdrop of rising antisemitism, the attack at the synagogue in Liège served as a stark reminder that the threat facing Belgium's Jewish community is very real.

posts.title: Rotterdam Synagogue Targeted in Arson as Attacks on Jews Rise Globally
posts.description: The Rotterdam attack comes amid rising global threats to Jewish communities, with recent incidents including a synagogue explosion in Belgium, shootings in Michigan and Toronto, and a car ramming at a New York synagogue.

posts.title: Belgium deploys military to protect Jewish sites after Iran-linked group claims Europe attacks
posts.description: Belgium increases security for Jewish community after antisemitic attack on Liège synagogue. Prime minister announces military deployment following explosion.

posts.title: Board of Peace focus on Hamas risks return to war in Gaza, critics say
posts.description: Focus on Hamas risks return to war in Gaza, say critics. May 23, 2026.

posts.title: Gaza marks 6 months of a ceasefire that may offer lessons for Iran and Lebanon
posts.description: Friday marks six months since Gaza's ceasefire deal took effect, a milestone largely lost in the confusion over the new and even more fragile ceasefire in the Iran war.

posts.title: Gaza risks becoming permanently divided, top official warns
posts.description: A prolonged stalemate in Gaza risks cementing the territory's permanent division, a top international official overseeing the ceasefire has warned, as Israel deepens its control over the enclave.

posts.title: Gaza ceasefire 'increasingly fragile' as Israeli strikes and armed activities by Hamas continue
posts.description: Since the ceasefire began, approximately 800 Palestinians, including more than 200 children, and seven humanitarian personnel, have been killed as a result of Israeli airstrikes. The IDF states its strikes have targeted Hamas militants.
